messages.author: 57adfeaf6a74fec2
messages.subject: Interpretation threshold endogenous outcome
parts:
Hello,

I am conducting a mediation analysis with an endogenous outcome (3 categories). 
How do I report the estimates of the threshold? Is it an OR? 

I couldn't find the answer, so if someone could help me :)

Kind regards, Angela

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Interpretation threshold endogenous outcome
parts: How do I report the estimates of the threshold? Is it an OR?

No, it is the value of a normally distributed latent response variable, above which the observed ordinal variable is discretized into (at least) that category.  Find details here:

ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3162326/

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
